description:
VirtualMachineMove: move one running VM to another Cloud Hypervisor host in
its zone, keeping its memory, disk, MAC and addresses (ADR-0127).

# What a move guarantees

- **The guest runs on exactly one host, always.** Failure before commit
  leaves it where it was; after commit the old copy is never booted again.
- **Admitted only where it can work**: same zone (`banlieue.io/zone`), both
  hosts advertising `move`, identical VMM version and CPU model, and a
  destination the VM's own placement allows. Otherwise `Rejected`, with a
  named reason.
- **One move per VM at a time.** Deleting a move before `HandingOver`
  cancels it; after that it runs to `Succeeded` or `Failed`.

# What a move is not

Not a restart elsewhere after a host failure: that is fencing and HA, and
banlieue does not do it. Until Stage 2 a VM with a vTPM is not movable.

target.description:
Where to move it. When absent, banlieue picks a host in the VM's zone:
of those passing every check, the one with the most free memory left
after the move, then the most free vCPUs, then by name (Decision 2).

providerSelector.description:
Restricts the destination to the zone's Providers matching it; banlieue
still ranks among them.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: target takes exactly one of providerName or providerSelector

vmRef.description: The VM to move, in the move's namespace. Immutable.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: vmRef is immutable: delete the move and create another

bytesTotal.description: Bytes the source has to send (disk extents and VMM state), once known.

conditions.description: Standard conditions; `Admitted` carries the rejection reason.

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description: lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another. This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description: message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition. This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description: observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon. For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description: reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition. Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field, and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API. The value should be a CamelCase string. This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

destination.description: The Provider chosen to receive it.

downtimeMilliseconds.description: How long the guest was paused, cutover to resume. Set on `Succeeded`.

phase.description: Where a move is. One way: nothing returns to an earlier phase.

source.description: The Provider the VM was on when the move was admitted.
